Product Technologist

We're looking for a versatile person to help our growing team.

You might work on a variety of things depending on the week. Some days
involve talking to customers, other days involve tinkering with internal
tools. A curious, self-driven attitude matters more to us than any
particular technology.

Experience with modern tooling is a plus. Comfort with ambiguity is
important. The ideal candidate enjoys learning.

We offer flexible hours and a supportive environment.
